jobs.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer (Enterprise AI / Python)
jobs.description:
This is a Fully Remote Job

1. About Our Client:

The organization operates in the financial wellness industry, providing a comprehensive global solution that supports employees' financial health throughout different life stages. It addresses challenges faced by HR teams in attracting, retaining, and engaging talent by delivering practical AI-powered financial wellness tools through a remote-first SaaS platform.

2. About the Opportunity:

The Senior Applied AI Engineer
is responsible for designing, building, and scaling AI systems within a production SaaS platform focused on financial wellness. This role enables the delivery of reliable, high-quality AI features by developing scalable infrastructure and frameworks, directly impacting the evolution of AI capabilities in the product architecture.

3. Responsibilities:

Design and implement scalable AI services and supporting infrastructure
Develop solutions to evaluate and improve large language model (LLM) output quality
Build frameworks and tooling to support AI feature development
Maintain systems for model tuning, evaluation, and optimization
Ensure deployment and operational reliability of AI services in production
Optimize AI services for latency, cost efficiency, and reliability
Collaborate with the CTO on AI architecture, model usage, and system design
Provide technical guidance and establish best practices for AI feature development
Participate in technical architecture discussions related to AI systems

4. Requirements:

5+ years of software engineering experience with strong backend or systems development skills
Proficiency in Python development
Experience designing and building backend services or distributed systems
Experience integrating LLM APIs or generative AI services into production
Experience evaluating or improving AI model performance in production
Strong problem-solving and systems design abilities
Ability to collaborate effectively in a cross-functional team

Nice to have:
Experience with FastAPI or similar frameworks
Experience with model fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt evaluation, or LLM evaluation
Experience building internal tooling or infrastructure for AI applications
Experience with vector databases or AI data pipelines
Experience in fintech or B2B SaaS environments

5. Pay Range and Compensation Package:

Estimated annual base salary range from $160,000 to $195,000, depending on qualifications, experience, and location
Eligible for annual performance bonus
Equity participation
Comprehensive benefits package

6. Benefits & Perks:

Medical insurance
Dental insurance
401(k)

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

jobs.title: Lab Assistant
jobs.description:
Job Summary And Responsibilities

As a Lab Assistant, you will play a crucial role in solving diagnostic mysteries, bringing us one step closer to effectively treating patient illnesses and injuries.

Every day you will utilize your expertise and our advanced technology to precisely collect, prepare, and process a diverse range of patient specimens (blood, urine, tissue, etc.) for various diagnostic tests.

To be successful in this role, you will possess a foundational understanding of laboratory procedures, demonstrate meticulous attention to detail, and maintain an eager commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

Ensures that safe laboratory practices, universal precautions and observance of OSHA and HIPAA regulations are used at all times.
Responsible for familiarity with MSDS guidelines and State of California regulations in relation to the laboratory.
Responsible for maintaining basic job standards for all Dignity Health- Central California positions by participating in all mandatory training sessions or work shops.
Evaluates the appropriate information needed to identify each patient's requirements relative to his/her age-specific needs.
Responsible for maintaining the phlebotomy skills necessary to provide care for patients ranging from neonates to geriatrics.
Once certified -responsible for the collection of arterial blood for the purpose of blood gas analysis only. Is directly accountable to the Medical Laboratory Director for this procedure.
Receives and processes specimens within established timelines. Evaluates specimens based on established guidelines for specimen appropriateness for tests ordered, specimen quality and specimen volume for number of test ordered.
Reviews orders for reference lab testing for specimen type and specimen handling instructions. Appropriately batches and sends testing to appropriate testing facility or reference laboratory.
Correctly aliquots and prepares specimens for send out testing.
Prepares blood smears and body fluid smears for Wright Stain and Gram Stain testing for Clinical Laboratory Scientist review.
During computer downtime situations is responsible for printing labels or using "downtime labels" if necessary and posting draws in appropriate area for the Lab Assistant.

Job Requirements

Minimum Requirements
:

CA Phlebotomy Technician 1 and BLS required.
CA Phlebotomy Technician 2 license must be obtained after completion of 1040 clinical hours.
One year experience in phlebotomy required.
Education level necessary to obtain required licensure and certifications.
Working knowledge of medical terminology
General typing/ computer skills

Please be advised that this location requires quarterly American Heart Association (AHA) Resuscitation Quality Improvement (RQI) competency certification post-hire. This ongoing competency is required through resources internal to the facility; outside RQI competency resources are not acceptable for CommonSpirit Health compliance requirements.

Where You'll Work

Founded in 1956, Dignity Health - Memorial Hospital is a 385-bed, acute care, nonprofit hospital located in Bakersfield, California. Serving nearly 100,000 patients annually, the hospital offers a full complement of services including heart care, maternity care, and orthopedics. Additionally, Memorial Hospital has been recognized as an LGBTQ+ Healthcare Equality Leader by the Human Rights Campaign Foundation. It is a Joint Commission-certified Primary Stroke Center, and its Lauren Small Children’s Center is the first comprehensive pediatric program in Kern County.

One Community. One Mission. One California

Pay Range

$27.71 - $33.13 /hour

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a curious and detail-oriented Data Analyst who enjoys working with data and turning it into meaningful insights. In this role, you’ll help us understand what the numbers are telling us, identify trends, and provide information that helps the team make better decisions.

You’ll work closely with different teams to understand their needs, solve business problems, and present findings in a clear and practical way. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable asking questions, enjoys solving problems, and can explain data in a way that makes sense to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

Key Responsibilities

Collect, clean, organize, and analyze data from different sources to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Work with business teams to understand their goals, challenges, and reporting needs.
Create and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Excel.
Use SQL to retrieve, manipulate, and analyze data from databases.
Identify patterns, trends, and potential issues that can help improve business performance.
Translate complex data into clear insights and practical recommendations.
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and prepare regular reports for stakeholders.
Investigate data discrepancies and work with relevant teams to resolve them.
Support business planning and decision-making through data-driven analysis.
Look for opportunities to improve reporting processes, data quality, and analytical workflows.

Skills And Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Good working knowledge of SQL and data analysis techniques.
Experience with Excel and at least one data visualization tool, such as Power BI or Tableau.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an eye for detail.
Ability to interpret data, recognize trends, and explain findings clearly.
Good communication skills and the ability to work with people across different teams.
A willingness to learn new tools, ask questions, and explore better ways of working.
Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy in day-to-day work.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means more than preparing reports. It means helping the team understand what is happening in the business and why. You’ll be successful when your analysis answers important questions, your reports are reliable and easy to understand, and your insights help people make informed decisions.

What We’re Looking For

We value someone who is thoughtful, dependable, and genuinely interested in understanding data. You don’t need to have every answer right away, but you should be comfortable exploring problems, learning from feedback, and working with others to find the right answers.

If you enjoy connecting the dots, finding meaning in numbers, and helping people make better decisions, we’d love to hear from you.
